property_summary: For any caller and value, the reference contract always allows SetMinSum(...) to succeed (not revert) when intitalized == false and sets MinSum to the provided value; the mutant inverts the check and instead only allows the call when intitalized == true, causing calls that should succeed to revert for some inputs.
change_summary: Inverted the initialization check so SetMinSum only sets MinSum when intitalized is true (previously reverted when intitalized was true).
